name: quickbox-e2e
description: E2E tests for QuickBox Lite Dashboard

scripts.docker:test: docker compose --env-file ./.env.compose run --rm playwright npx playwright test
scripts.e2e: npm run docker:up && E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8880 WS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8880/ws npx playwright test; npm run docker:down
scripts.e2e:docker: npm run docker:up && docker compose --env-file ./.env.compose run --rm playwright npx playwright test; npm run docker:down
